.. change::
    :tags: bug, postgresql, asyncio
    :tickets: 13655
    :versions: 2.1.5

    Documented that as of asyncpg 2.1, the :func:`str` form of asyncpg
    exceptions no longer includes the PostgreSQL ``DETAIL`` line; this content
    is instead available via the asyncpg exception attributes, such as
    ``exc.orig.detail`` on a :class:`.DBAPIError`, or through
    :attr:`.DBAPIError.driver_exception`.
